Initial release of xlsx-generation.

- Provides full-featured Excel spreadsheet generation with professional design specification, template system, and data processing.
- Supports structured data input, style and layout systems, data validation, analysis features, and compatibility with Microsoft Excel (.xlsx).
- Includes built-in color, font, and layout standards, plus preset and custom templates for common use cases.
- Strict output and formatting rules ensure usability and file compatibility.
- SKILL.md details usage, execution flow, and modular structure for clarity and extensibility.
